user.title: Irrigation Maestro
user.description: Pick the weather source and, optionally, the sensors and master valve. Everything can be changed later in the options; zones are added afterwards as subentries.

data_description.weather_entity: Provides temperatures and precipitation forecasts for the watering decisions.
data_description.rain_sensor: Cumulative daily rain sensor (mm). If not set, rain is estimated from the weather forecasts.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Overrides the weather entity's temperature for daily maximum tracking.
data_description.line_flow_sensor: Shared flow meter on the supply line (L/min), used by zones without their own meter.
data_description.master_valve: Valve or switch opened before any zone and closed after the last one.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance of Irrigation Maestro is possible.

data_description.weather_entity: Provides temperatures and precipitation forecasts for the watering decisions.
data_description.rain_sensor: Cumulative daily rain sensor (mm). If not set, rain is estimated from the weather forecasts.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Overrides the weather entity's temperature for daily maximum tracking.
data_description.line_flow_sensor: Shared flow meter on the supply line (L/min), used by zones without their own meter.
data_description.master_valve: Valve or switch opened before any zone and closed after the last one.
data_description.master_pre_open_s: Seconds the master valve is opened before the first zone.
data_description.master_post_close_s: Seconds the master valve stays open after the last zone closes.
data_description.max_concurrent: How many zones may water at the same time.
data_description.compatibility_groups: Comma-separated group names; only zones in the same group may run together.

data_description.settle_pause_s: Seconds of pause between one zone closing and the next one opening.
data_description.manual_block_min: Minutes automatic watering stays blocked after a manual stop.
data_description.watchdog_max_min: A zone running longer than this is closed and reported.
data_description.open_confirm_s: Cancel the zone if the valve does not report open within this time.
data_description.close_confirm_s: Escalate if the valve does not report closed within this time.
data_description.switch_confirm_s: Optimistic wait after commanding switch-based valves.
data_description.wait_free_min: Minutes a due cycle may wait for a compatible free slot before being skipped.
data_description.startup_valve_timeout_s: How long to wait for valve entities to become available after a restart.
data_description.sentinel_time: Time of the daily consistency check.
data_description.must_finish_by: Cycles that would end after this time are not started. Leave empty for no limit.

engine_advanced.title: Engine (advanced)
engine_advanced.description: Weights and thresholds of the watering decision engine. Only change these if you know what you are doing — 'Reset to defaults' restores the field-validated values.

data_description.temp_weights: Five comma-separated weights: day −3, day −2, yesterday, today, tomorrow.
data_description.rain_weights: Four comma-separated weights: today, yesterday, day −2, day −3.
data_description.forecast_credit_weights: Two comma-separated weights: rain forecast 0–24 h and 24–48 h.
data_description.season_months: Months in which watering is considered at all. Zones can override this.
data_description.stale_weather_max_h: Hours without weather updates before the data counts as stale.
data_description.stale_weather_policy: fail_open waters despite stale data, fail_closed skips.
data_description.reset_to_defaults: Discard every value on this page and restore the built-in defaults.

data_description.allowed_weekdays: Leave empty to allow every day. 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday.
data_description.parity: Restrict watering to odd or even days of the month.
data_description.forbidden_windows: Comma-separated windows such as '08:00-10:30, 22:00-23:15'. Leave empty for none.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Pick the event to configure; the next step sets its targets and priority.

data_description.services: One or more notify services that receive this event.

data_description.liters_per_month: Leave empty to disable the budget.
data_description.action: notify only reports, reduce shortens watering, suspend stops it until the next period.
data_description.reduce_pct: How much watering is shortened when the action is 'reduce'.

error.invalid_time_window: Windows must look like '08:00-10:30', separated by commas.

user.title: New zone
user.description: Valve, flow metering and scheduling for one irrigation zone. Cycles are added in the next step.

data_description.valve_entity: Valve or switch that opens this zone.
data_description.flow_sensor: Per-zone flow meter (L/min); if empty, the shared line meter is used when available.
data_description.nominal_flow_lpm: Expected flow while watering, used for anomaly detection.
data_description.flow_tolerance_pct: Allowed deviation from the nominal flow before an anomaly is reported.
data_description.adjustment_pct: Scales the curve output, applied before the clamps. 100% = unchanged.
data_description.interval_days: Water at most every N days (1–60).
data_description.season_months: Overrides the hub season for this zone. Leave empty to use the hub default.

data_description.valve_entity: Valve or switch that opens this zone.
data_description.flow_sensor: Per-zone flow meter (L/min); if empty, the shared line meter is used when available.
data_description.nominal_flow_lpm: Expected flow while watering, used for anomaly detection.
data_description.flow_tolerance_pct: Allowed deviation from the nominal flow before an anomaly is reported.
data_description.adjustment_pct: Scales the curve output, applied before the clamps. 100% = unchanged.
data_description.interval_days: Water at most every N days (1–60).
data_description.season_months: Overrides the hub season for this zone. Leave empty to use the hub default.

cycle_menu.title: Cycles of {zone_name}
cycle_menu.description: Configured cycles: {cycles}. At least one cycle is required.

data_description.kind: Start relative to sunrise/sunset, or at a fixed time.
data_description.months_override: Restrict this cycle to certain months. Leave empty to follow the zone.

data_description.offset_min: Negative = before the event, positive = after. At most ±360 minutes.

cycle_curve.title: Watering curve
cycle_curve.description: How the watering amount follows the weighted temperature.

data_description.soak_max_run_min: Split the cycle into runs of at most this length. Leave empty to water in one go.
data_description.volume_safety_timeout_min: For volume curves only: hard stop if the target volume is never reached.

data_description.points: Comma-separated 'temperature:value' pairs with increasing temperatures, e.g. '10:5, 25:15, 35:30'.
data_description.min_value: Lower clamp applied after the adjustment factor.
data_description.max_value: Upper clamp applied after the adjustment factor.
data_description.kind: Minutes (duration) or liters (volume). Volume needs a usable flow meter.

error.interval_out_of_range: The interval must be between 1 and 60 days.
error.offset_out_of_range: The offset must be within ±360 minutes.
error.curve_empty: Enter at least one control point.
error.curve_negative_value: Point values must not be negative.
error.curve_temps_not_increasing: Point temperatures must be strictly increasing.
error.min_above_max: The minimum must not exceed the maximum.
error.negative_clamp: The minimum must not be negative.
error.duration_out_of_range: Durations must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
error.volume_requires_flow: Volume curves need a zone flow sensor or a line flow sensor on the hub.
error.soak_pause_without_max: A soak pause needs a maximum run time as well.
error.copy_source_missing: That cycle no longer exists — pick another one.

run_zone.name: Run zone
run_zone.description: Waters one zone now. Decision gates (cadence, budget, season) are bypassed; safety gates still apply.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone id (the zone_id attribute of the zone's entities).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Watering duration in minutes. If omitted, the cycle curve decides.

run_all.name: Run all zones
run_all.description: Waters every enabled, non-suspended zone now, in the configured order.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to skip. Omit to skip every zone.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Pauses automatic watering for a number of hours.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to pause. Omit to pause globally.

suspend_until.name: Suspend until
suspend_until.description: Suspends automatic watering until a date and time.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to suspend. Omit to suspend every zone.

zone_id.name: Zone
zone_id.description: The zone to resume. Omit to clear the global pause and every zone.

stop_all.name: Stop all
stop_all.description: Closes every valve, cancels the queue and blocks automatic watering for the configured window.

evaluate.name: Evaluate
evaluate.description: Runs one engine evaluation and returns the full watering plan as the response.

set_zone_order.name: Set zone order
set_zone_order.description: Changes a zone's watering priority (zones water in ascending order).

set_curve.name: Set curve
set_curve.description: Replaces a cycle's watering curve with inline control points.

cycle_id.name: Cycle
cycle_id.description: The cycle whose curve is replaced.

points.name: Control points
points.description: List of [temperature, value] pairs with strictly increasing temperatures.

min_value.name: Minimum
min_value.description: Lower clamp. If omitted, the current minimum is kept.

max_value.name: Maximum
max_value.description: Upper clamp. If omitted, the current maximum is kept.

export_config.name: Export configuration
export_config.description: Returns the hub options and every zone's configuration as a JSON string.

import_config.name: Import configuration
import_config.description: Applies a previously exported configuration to the hub and its existing zones.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: The JSON string produced by export_config.

weather_unavailable.title: Weather data unavailable
weather_unavailable.description: The weather data could not be fetched at evaluation time. The configured stale-weather policy was applied. Check the weather integration and the configured weather entity.

close_failed.title: Valve did not close
close_failed.description: The valve {entity_id} did not confirm closure after a retry. The watchdog keeps trying; if water still flows, close the supply manually and check the valve hardware.

valve_unreachable.title: Valve unreachable
valve_unreachable.description: The valve {entity_id} has been unavailable for too long. Zones using it cannot water; check its power and radio connection.

sentinel_missing_outcome.title: Scheduled watering did not run
sentinel_missing_outcome.description: No outcome was recorded today for: {cycles}. The trigger probably never fired (Home Assistant was off at trigger time, or an unexpected error occurred).

invalid_points.message: Invalid curve points ({error}): temperatures must be strictly increasing and values must not be negative.

min_above_max.message: The minimum must not exceed the maximum.

invalid_payload.message: The payload is not a valid exported configuration.

unknown_import_zone.message: The payload references a zone that does not exist: {zone_id}.
